tools.name: get_visitor_alerts
tools.description: Current closures, cautions and access notices for Hawaii trails, parks, attractions and scenic roads, each with its official source and the date HawaiiGuide last checked it. Use for questions like "is the Kalalau Trail open" or "what is closed on Kauai".

tools.name: find_planning_tools
tools.description: Directory of HawaiiGuide's free interactive tools: trip cost calculators, itinerary builder, beach, hike and luau finders, live conditions pages and more. Returns the tool page to send the traveler to. The tools are web pages, not callable functions.

tools.name: get_decision_briefs
tools.description: Editor-reviewed decision briefs for a small set of major Hawaii attractions: a verdict, who it suits, when to choose something else, key planning facts, official sources and the fact-check date.

tools.name: get_gas_prices
tools.description: Daily average gas prices per gallon for the state and for Oahu, Maui, the Big Island and Kauai, from AAA, with the source date.

tools.name: get_box_jellyfish_watch_windows
tools.description: Upcoming box jellyfish watch windows for Hawaii's south-facing shores such as Waikiki and Ala Moana, calculated from the lunar cycle (days 8 to 12 after each full moon). A planning estimate, not a sighting report.
